snippet: Hi Mateo, we would like to invite you to a technical conversation on Thursday 17 September at 10:00 Monterrey time. The invitation is attached.
bodyText:
Hi Mateo,

Thanks for your patience. We would like to invite you to a 60 minute technical conversation with Elias Novak, our staff ML engineer, on Thursday 17 September at 10:00 Monterrey time (UTC-6).

The calendar invitation is attached and includes the video link: https://meet.quarry-ai.example/mc-7731

Please reply if the time does not work.

Best regards,
Maya Chen
Talent partner, Quarry AI
